glossary.definition: "Private correctional facility" means a correctional facility in this state that houses out-of-state prisoners and that is operated by a private contractor under a contract with a local public entity pursuant to section 9.07 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 109.39 - [Former R.C. 103.73, amended and renumbered as R.C. 109.39 by H.B. 96, 136th General Assembly, effective 9/30/2025] Office of correctional facility inspection services.

glossary.definition:
"Youth services facility" means a facility operated, or contracted for, by the department of youth services that is used for the care, protection, treatment, or secure confinement of any child committed to the department's custody.
